notes.title: TetherGeist at PAX West 2025!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello friends! 

As the completion of TetherGeist moves ever closer we are excited to show off the game's progress at this year's PAX West in Seattle, Washington!

Though we are stoked to show off loads of new content at the event, we aren't quite ready to announce a release date yet. But we thank you for your continued patience and all the love and support you've shown our tiny team.

For anybody in town for PAX West, please come by and say hi! We'll be at booth #438 all weekend and will also present TG at the MIX event the same week.

MIX Event Details Date:
Friday, August 29 Location:
Block 41, 115 Bell Street, Seattle WA

You're the best!  

Jordan, Noah and Rae[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412966/d45c61a1931148bf2135836c76c84f54599b567c.jpg"][/img][/p]
